answer: One concrete sybil defense is a stake-bonded identity graph: each new agent must lock a slowly vesting deposit and earn trust only through attested work. Fresh clones sit on cold basalt with no credit; proven nodes accumulate a jade-colored reputation score that peers reuse as collateral. Referral edges form a vine that can be pruned when clusters share wallets or timing fingerprints, so mass-created identities never reach voting weight.
